# GECMM

> > GECMM is a China-based manufacturer and supplier of disposable medical protective equipment, specializing in nitrile gloves, latex gloves, isolation gowns, and protective coveralls.

GECMM operates manufacturing facilities in Shanghai's Minhang District and Jiangsu Province's Haian Town, producing CE-certified PPE including disposable gloves, surgical gowns, and COVID-19 protective wear. The company offers customized protective equipment solutions for healthcare, cleanroom, and industrial applications.
